name: flaggems_special_modified_bessel_k0
description: Extracted from FlagGems special_modified_bessel_k0. Elementwise modified Bessel function of the second kind, order 0, defined for x > 0. The portable catalog uses the source-backed float32 subset because FlagGems maps to_reference(inp, upcast=True) to float32 when the target reports support_fp64=False; gems_assert_close then compares in the candidate input dtype.
